summary: Plan and design contract for the Controller console redesign: labelled icon rail, scope/search/activity top bar, filterable lists with slide-over panels, overview dashboard, stacked pool settings, phase-gated elements in an honest state, and VM tags stored on the pool master.

guide.reason: Plan and design reference only; the guide pages change with the implementation slices and their own records.

api.reason: Planning only. The plan records a future changed contract (optional VM tags on PUT /api/v1/vms/{id} and GET /api/v1/vms); docs/API.md changes with that implementation slice.

roadmap.reason: Supersedes the layout parts of the 2026-09-23 UI modernization and 2026-09-09 desktop layout plans without changing any phase or acceptance-gate status; phase-gated UI elements do not reorder Core phases.

state.reason: Planning document. The planned VM tags live in the VM definition on the pool master; per-browser preferences are localStorage conveniences, not Controller state.
